description: List bounties. Filter by status, category, skill, or price range. Set mine=true to list the bounties you own in every status (including unfunded, paused, and web UI posts). Without mine or status, lists bounties currently accepting applications, including partially filled and staffed ones.

includePartiallyFilled.description: With status 'open', also include partially filled and staffed bounties still recruiting (default: true)

mine.description: List bounties owned by the authenticated account, including bounties posted from the web UI and through MCP/API keys.

status.description: Filter by status: open, assigned, completed, paid, closed, or cancelled (other values return 400). Omit to list bounties accepting applications (with mine=true, all your bounties).

name: list_bounties
title: List bounties
